### Checkbox An accessible set of selection controls supporting individual checkboxes, group management, grid layout columns, selectable card mode, and helper hooks. **Import Path**: ```typescript import { Checkbox, CheckboxGroup, useCheckboxGroup } from "@/components/ui/checkbox/checkbox"; ``` #### Colors Defines the checked color theme using the 'color' prop. ```tsx ``` #### Single Checkbox Standard individual checkbox. ```tsx ``` #### Group Select All / Deselect All Hook Easily manage batch select all and deselect all state using the 'useCheckboxGroup' hook. ```tsx const { selected, setSelected, isAllSelected, isSomeSelected, toggleAll } = useCheckboxGroup({ items: ["react", "nextjs", "tailwind", "typescript"], defaultSelected: ["react", "tailwind"], });
``` #### Selectable Card Mode with Start / End Content Slots Custom positions for start/end content slots and checkbox control placement inside card containers. ```tsx } /> } /> ``` #### Indeterminate State Used for parent checkboxes representing partial selection in hierarchical trees. ```tsx const [componentsState, setComponentsState] = React.useState({ input: true, select: true, checkbox: true, slider: false, datepicker: false, }); ``` #### Checkbox Group with Grid Columns Manage group selection with controlled value array and grid layout columns. ```tsx const [values, setValues] = React.useState(["email", "push"]); ``` #### Required State Displays an asterisk next to the label indicating that the checkbox must be checked. ```tsx ``` #### Props — Checkbox & CheckboxGroup Supported properties for Checkbox & CheckboxGroup. | Prop | Type | Default | Description | |---|---|---|---| | isCard | boolean | false | Encloses control inside interactive card container with animated borders. | | startContent | ReactNode | — | Content slot rendered at the start of the layout. | | endContent | ReactNode | — | Content slot rendered at the end of the layout. | | checkboxPosition | 'start' | 'end' | 'start' | Placement of the checkbox input root element inside the layout. | | isIndeterminate | boolean | false | Applies partial selection dash indicator for hierarchical parent items. | | columns (Group) | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | — | Arranges group checkboxes into grid columns. | | orientation (Group) | 'horizontal' | 'vertical' | 'vertical' | Layout direction for non-grid group items. |
